apply.title: Apply settings
apply.description: Copy groups of settings from one frame to others. This replaces those settings on the other frames.

hint.Color: Balance, temperature, tint, saturation and black and white.
hint.Tone: Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, dehaze and the curves.
hint.Geometry: The crop, turns, flips and straightening. Frames are not always cropped the same.
hint.Base: Where the film base comes from, and its values.
hint.Invert: The black and white points of the inversion.
